dct_description_sm:
The Biobanque québécoise de la COVID-19 (BQC19) is a cohort that provides a rich source of clinically characterised patient samples and datasets, including whole-genome sequencing, transcriptomics, metabolomics, immunoserology, proteomics, and clinical laboratory analyses. This comprehensive multi-omics investigation seeks to contribute to the expanding compendium of COVID-19 knowledge, harmonising insights gleaned from diverse molecular strata.

This is a controlled-access dataset that is not hosted on Borealis. To obtain access, a formal data access request must be submitted and approved.
dct_rights_sm: To access the BQC19 dataset, please complete the Data Access Request form attached to this record and email it to info@bqc19.ca. The form includes all applicable Terms of Use.
